description: This file defines error types, issue codes, and error handling classes for the Superset project, including error categorization, mapping to issue codes, and a data class for representing errors.

classes.name: SupersetErrorType
classes.description: Enumeration of various error types within Superset, including frontend, database, visualization, security, and other errors.

classes.name: ErrorLevel
classes.description: Enumeration of error severity levels: info, warning, and error.

classes.name: SupersetError
classes.description: Data class representing an error returned to a client, with logic to attach issue codes based on error type.

methods.name: __post_init__
methods.description: Post-initialization method that updates the 'extra' field with issue codes and messages based on the error type.

methods.name: to_dict
methods.description: Converts the SupersetError instance into a dictionary suitable for serialization.
